note: Upgrade cost curves. ALL NUMBERS HERE ARE PLACEHOLDERS - FC Mobile's real cost scaling was not verifiable from a free public source. The app shows an 'UNVERIFIED' badge wherever these are used. Edit them in the UI (Rules -> Costs) to match what the game charges you.

training.note: Cost to raise a player from training level L to L+1. Index 0 = level 0->1, ... index 29 = level 29->30.

rankup.note: Cost (rank-up items) to go from rank r to r+1. Index 0 = rank 0->1, ... index 4 = rank 4->5.

normalization.note: For the COMBINED upgrade ranking, costs from different currencies are converted into one common 'unit' by these multipliers, because 1 training-XP, 1 rank item and 1 skill point are not worth the same. These conversions are a rough guess - edit them to reflect how scarce each resource is for you. Combined cost = raw_cost * (multiplier for its type).
